name: about.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  about.scss — the About section on the home page: bio text + Gravatar card.
//  Layout: %MAXAREA column, metallic hairline top edge + filament-glow
//  background accent, draw-text paragraphs staggered left, profile card right.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// Shadow host.
:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
}

// About section — %MAXAREA column with filament-glow accent. The metallic
// hairline top border only runs ≥768 — on stacked mobile layout it reads as
// a stray divider floating between the bio and the mentions.
.about {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  background-image: var(--filament-glow);
  padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
  // Smooth transition when masonry above changes height (hover expand/collapse)
  transition: padding-top 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  @include layout-768() {
    border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid transparent;
    border-image: var(--metallic-hairline) 1;
    padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-top: to-rem($space-5xl);
  }
  // Isolate internal layout shifts from contributing to page-level CLS
  contain: layout;

  // ── Title ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-xl;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 100;
    text-align: left;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
    @include layout-1440() {
      padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-4xl);
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      padding: 0 0 to-rem($space-5xl);
    }
  }

  // ── Profile picture + 2-column text row ─────────────────────────────────
  // Grid: [pic 2fr] [gap 1fr] [text-1 5fr] [gap 1fr] [text-2 5fr]
  // The .ab-pf-text wrapper uses display:contents at 1024px+ so its
  // two children become direct grid items in columns 3 and 5.
  &-profile-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);

    @include layout-768() {
      // Tablet: picture on top (row 1, full width), text cols side-by-side below (row 2)
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto auto;
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      // Full grid: 2fr gap 5fr gap 5fr  (14 fractional units)
      // Cols: 1=pic, 2=gap, 3=text-1, 4=gap, 5=text-2
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 5fr 1fr 5fr;
      grid-template-rows: auto;
      gap: 0;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-6xl);
    }
  }

  &-profile-picture {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    // Mobile / 768px: fixed square size driven by space tokens
    width: to-rem($space-5xl);
    height: to-rem($space-5xl);
    margin: 0;
    // Stay in column 1 on all grid layouts
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: 1;

    @include layout-540() {
      width: to-rem($space-6xl);
      height: to-rem($space-6xl);
    }

    @include layout-768() {
      // Tablet: picture spans both columns (full width), sits in row 1
      grid-column: 1 / 3;
      grid-row: 1;
      width: to-rem($space-6xl);
      height: to-rem($space-6xl);
      // Center the circular pic horizontally within full-width row
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      // On 5-col full grid: picture in col 1
      grid-column: 1;
      grid-row: 1;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      margin: 0;
    }

    @include layout-1440() {
      margin: 0;
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      margin: 0;
    }

    &-img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      display: block;
      will-change: transform;
    }

    // Glitch on hover — hard steps() jumps between horizontal clip slices,
    // pixel jitter and hue/saturation bursts. Mostly clean frames so the
    // effect reads as interference, not constant distortion. A chromatic
    // drop-shadow pair fakes the RGB split using the themed accent ink.
    &:hover &-img,
    &:focus-visible &-img {
      animation: about-glitch 1.1s steps(1, end) infinite;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      &:hover &-img,
      &:focus-visible &-img {
        animation: none;
      }
    }

    // Shadow DOM: mirror the store-driven reduced-motion flag.
    :host-context(html.reduced-motion) &:hover &-img,
    :host-context(html.reduced-motion) &:focus-visible &-img {
      animation: none;
    }

    // Skeleton shimmer while loading
    &-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--skel-bg-1);

      &::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--skel-bg-2) 50%, transparent 100%);
        transform: translateX(-100%);
        animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
        will-change: transform;
        pointer-events: none;
      }
    }
  }

  &-profile-text {
    flex: 1;
    // Mobile: single column, no gap — paragraphs provide their own padding-bottom
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0;

    @include layout-768() {
      // Tablet: text wrapper spans both columns in row 2
      grid-column: 1 / 3;
      grid-row: 2;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      // On full 5-col grid: profile-text uses display:contents so its
      // two children become direct grid items in cols 3 and 5.
      display: contents;
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      gap: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    &-col {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      word-break: normal;
      hyphens: none;

      @include layout-1024() {
        // First text col → grid column 3 (the <details> side-info wrapper
        // takes column 5 — see &-side-info below).
        &:first-child {
          grid-column: 3;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // ── Side info (extended bio) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  // The second text column reads as secondary info: far-right grid slot on
  // ≥1024px, secondary ink alone carries the hierarchy on narrow viewports
  // (no separator — a hairline above the mentions read as a stray divider).
  &-side-info {
    .about-item-text {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      grid-column: 5;
    }
  }

  // ── Shared item/text ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  &-item {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    position: relative;

    &-text {
      @extend .txt-md;

      font-family: var(--font-primary);
      font-weight: 250;
      word-break: normal;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      hyphens: none;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-md);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
      }
      @include layout-1280() {
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
      @include layout-1680() {
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }

      a {
        @extend %LK_LINK;

        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
      }
    }
  }

  .skeleton-about-title {
    display: inline-block;
    width: 40%;
    height: 1em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  .skeleton-about-p1 {
    width: 100%;
    height: 1.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
  }

  .skeleton-about-p2 {
    width: 88%;
    height: 1.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
  }

  .skeleton-about-p3 {
    width: 70%;
    height: 1.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  .skeleton-about-p4 {
    width: 95%;
    height: 1.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    margin-bottom: 0.6em;
  }

  .skeleton-about-p5 {
    width: 80%;
    height: 1.4em;
    border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
  }

  &-container {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);

    @include layout-1440() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }
    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-6xl);
    }
  }

  // ── Awards grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  .awards {
    display: grid;
    grid-gap: to-rem($space-2xl);

    @include layout-540() {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
    @include layout-768() {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    }
    @include layout-1024() {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    }
    @include layout-1920() {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    }
    @include layout-3840() {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
    }

    &-item {
      border-radius: to-rem($space-sm);
      background: var(--grey-2);
      box-shadow: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm) 0 rgba($color-black, 0.15);
      overflow: hidden;

      &-link {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: to-rem($space-4xl) auto;
        min-height: 100%;
        align-items: center;
        text-decoration: none;
        color: inherit;

        @include layout-2560() {
          grid-template-columns: to-rem($space-5xl) auto;
        }

        &-media {
          width: 100%;
          height: auto;
          text-align: center;
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          background: var(--grey-2);
          font-size: to-rem($space-2xl);
          line-height: to-rem($space-4xl);
          min-height: 100%;

          @include layout-2560() {
            font-size: to-rem($space-3xl);
            line-height: to-rem($space-5xl);
          }
        }

        &-text {
          @extend .txt-xs;
          padding: 0 to-rem($space-lg);

          @include layout-1440() {
            padding: 0 to-rem($space-xl);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

// Glitch keyframes — irregular bursts: clean frames dominate, slices of the
// image jump with translate + hue/saturate spikes, then settle. steps(1,end)
// keeps each frame hard-edged (no interpolation = digital, not motion blur).
@keyframes about-glitch {
  0%,
  100% {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: translate(0);
    filter: none;
  }

  8% {
    clip-path: inset(12% 0 74% 0);
    transform: translate(to-rem(-$space-2xs), to-rem($space-3xs));
    filter: hue-rotate(60deg) saturate(3);
  }

  16% {
    clip-path: inset(58% 0 22% 0);
    transform: translate(to-rem($space-2xs), to-rem(-$space-3xs));
    filter: hue-rotate(-45deg);
  }

  24% {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: translate(0);
    filter: none;
  }

  48% {
    clip-path: inset(38% 0 44% 0);
    transform: translate(to-rem(-$space-3xs), 0);
    filter: contrast(1.6) hue-rotate(120deg);
  }

  56% {
    clip-path: inset(80% 0 6% 0);
    transform: translate(to-rem($space-3xs), to-rem($space-3xs));
    filter: saturate(4) hue-rotate(-90deg);
  }

  64% {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: translate(0);
    filter: none;
  }

  82% {
    clip-path: inset(24% 0 58% 0);
    transform: translate(to-rem($space-2xs), to-rem(-$space-2xs));
    filter: hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(2.5);
  }

  90% {
    clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0);
    transform: translate(0);
    filter: none;
  }
}

// ── Awards footer (below Contact, same dark background) ──────────────────────
.about-aw-ft {
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  background: var(--bg-dark);
  color: $color-white;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
  }
  @include layout-2560() {
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
  }

  // The awards carousel itself — limit max width so it feels compact & centred
  .aw-c--awards {
    max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    width: 100%;
  }

  // Legal links row: same border + padding as .contact-social
  &-skel {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: to-rem($space-xl) 0;
  }
}

// Awards links row.
.about-awards-links {
  @extend .ttl-xs;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0;
  color: var(--white);
  width: 100%;
  padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-lg) 0;
  border-top: to-rem($space-hairline) solid var(--grey);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-lg);

  @include layout-768() {
    padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-4xl) 0;
  }

  &-item {
    @extend .ttl-xs;
    @extend %LK_LINK;

    color: var(--white);
    text-decoration: none;
    line-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  &-sep {
    padding: 0 to-rem($space-md);
    font-weight: 200;
  }
}
